name: Seduce Me: The Holiday Episode
source:
"I get to spend the end of the year with the incubi! I am so excited! What will happen?"

You spent your holiday with your family... the New Years, however, is spent with the incubi! What will happen?

Who will you see the new year with?

[From [url=https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/seduce-me-the-otome-episode-series]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我可以和魅魔们一起度过年末！太兴奋了！会发生什么呢？”

你与家人一起度过了假期……然而，新年却要和魅魔们一起过！会发生什么？

你会和谁一起迎接新年？

（来源：[url=https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/seduce-me-the-otome-episode-series]itch.io[/url]）
